contents.reason: The source treats independent homoscedastic noise. The local theorem proves the general nonzero-mean formula for arbitrary positive-semidefinite observation-noise covariance R and an explicitly positive-definite observed block.

contents.name: Multiple test inputs and noisy prediction covariance
contents.reason: The local theorem handles arbitrary finite test lists, repeated indices, and independent prediction noise by a joint finite-dimensional Gaussian calculation.
